    resolve(List) - Method in class model.cards.eventCards.CavePaintingsEventCard
    Algorithmic Resolution Pipeline: Computes the current environmental threshold coefficient: eraIndex = era.ordinal() + 1. Iterates through each active game participant to track resource and score deltas. Evaluates demographic eligibility: if a player's total artist count falls strictly below the computed eraIndex, a flat penalty of 2 prestige points is deducted.
    resolve(List) - Method in class model.cards.eventCards.EventCard
    Executes the global event resolution logic across all active game participants.
    resolve(List) - Method in class model.cards.eventCards.HuntEventCard
    Algorithmic Resolution Pipeline: Computes the chronological scaling index: eraIndex = era.ordinal() + 1 (e.g., 1 for ERA_I, 2 for ERA_II, 3 for ERA_III). Iterates through each active game participant to evaluate state metrics. Applies linear primary yields: directly credits the player with 1 food unit per hunter, and awards prestige points equivalent to hunterCount * eraIndex. Dispatches lifecycle callbacks to all registered OnEventBuildingEffect instances executing the OnEventBuildingEffect.applyOnHunt(Player) hook to resolve building-specific bonuses. Snapshots mutated resource pools and compiles the delta metrics into a client-bound PlayerEventDeltaDto wrapper.
    resolve(List) - Method in class model.cards.eventCards.ShamanicRitualEventCard
    Algorithmic Resolution Pipeline: Computes the chronological scaling index: eraIndex = era.ordinal() + 1. Demographic Audit: Iterates through all players to map total shamanic star weights.
    resolve(List) - Method in class model.cards.eventCards.SustenanceEventCard
    Algorithmic Resolution Pipeline: Computes the chronological scaling index: eraIndex = era.ordinal() + 1. Iterates through each active game participant to evaluate demographic maintenance prerequisites. Baseline Discount Compilation: Retrieves the initial resource discount yielded inherently by gatherer cards inside the tribe via Tribe.getTotalGatherersDiscount(). Building Hook Interception: Dispatches a polling loop to all registered OnEventBuildingEffect instances via OnEventBuildingEffect.applyOnSustenance(Player) to accumulate additional structural or conditional food cost reductions. Requirement Balancing: Calculates the net required food as Math.max(0, population - discount). Penalty Resolution: If the net requirement strictly exceeds zero, delegates the subtraction to Player.removeFoodWithPrestigePenalty(int, int), which exhausts the current food inventory before applying a converted prestige point loss scaled by eraIndex. State Serialization: Packages individual asset deltas and details metrics into client-bound PlayerEventDeltaDto data wrappers.
